cards.defJa: 国の数を数えるときに使うことば。

passage.ja: 都内のある日本語学校には、現在およそ三十カ国から留学生が集まっている。授業はすべて日本語で行われ、教室では母語の違う学生どうしが身ぶりを交えながら懸命に言葉を探す。卒業後は日本で就職する人も多く、学校は地元の企業と組んで面接の練習にも力を入れている。
passage.en: At one Japanese language school in Tokyo, international students from about thirty countries are currently enrolled. All classes are taught in Japanese, and in the classroom students with different native languages search hard for words with the help of gestures. Many find jobs in Japan after graduating, so the school has teamed up with local companies and is also putting effort into interview practice.

cards.meaning: counter for months (a number of months)
cards.defJa: ひと月を単位として、期間の長さを数えることば。

passage.ja: この会社では、新しく入った社員に三ヶ月の試用期間を設けている。その間は先輩が一人ずつ付き、仕事の進め方や社内の決まりを丁寧に教える。期間の終わりには本人と上司が面談し、困っていることや今後の目標を話し合う。こうした仕組みを取り入れてから、入社一年以内に辞める人が目に見えて減ったという。
passage.en: This company gives new employees a three-month probation period. During that time a senior colleague is assigned to each of them and carefully teaches how to go about the work and the company's rules. At the end of the period, the employee and their manager sit down to discuss any difficulties and goals for the future. Since the system was introduced, the number of people quitting within their first year has visibly fallen.

cards.meaning: a mouthful, a bite; a sip
cards.defJa: 口に一回入れる量。また、少しだけ食べたり飲んだりすること。

passage.ja: 店主が勧める栗まんじゅうを一口かじると、ほくほくした栗の甘さが口いっぱいに広がった。中のあんは甘さを控えめにし、栗の香りを生かすよう毎朝店で炊いているという。昔ながらの和菓子は若い世代に敬遠されがちだが、この店には連日、写真を撮りに訪れる学生の姿も目立つ。
passage.en: When I took a bite of the chestnut bun the owner recommended, the sweetness of soft, tender chestnut filled my mouth. The bean paste inside is cooked in the shop every morning and kept only lightly sweet to bring out the chestnut's aroma. Old-fashioned Japanese sweets tend to be shunned by younger people, but day after day this shop also draws students who come to take photos.

cards.meaning: (not) at all, (not) in the least (adverbial, followed by a negative)
cards.defJa: 少しも。まったく。あとに打ち消しのことばが続く。

passage.ja: 寝る前にスマートフォンを見るのをやめてみたが、寝つきの悪さは一向に改善しない。専門医によれば、不眠の原因は光だけでなく、日中の運動不足やカフェインのとり方にあることも多い。まずは毎朝同じ時間に起きて日光を浴び、体内時計を整えることが大切だという。
passage.en: I tried giving up looking at my smartphone before bed, but my trouble falling asleep has not improved in the slightest. According to specialists, the causes of insomnia often lie not only in light but also in too little daytime exercise and in how one takes caffeine. The first step, they say, is to get up at the same time every morning and get some sunlight to set the body clock right.

cards.meaning: a single effort; all at once, at a stroke (adverbial use)
cards.defJa: 一度の行動。また、一度にまとめて物事を行うこと。

passage.ja: 明治の初め、新橋と横浜を結ぶ鉄道が開通すると、それまで歩いて半日近くかかった道のりが一挙に一時間足らずに縮まった。人々は驚き、汽車をひと目見ようと遠くから見物客が押し寄せたという。鉄道網はその後全国に広がり、物や人の流れを大きく変えていった。
passage.en: In the early Meiji era, when the railway linking Shimbashi and Yokohama opened, a journey that had taken nearly half a day on foot was cut at a stroke to less than an hour. People were astonished, and sightseers reportedly flocked from far away to catch a glimpse of the steam trains. The rail network then spread across the country, greatly changing the flow of goods and people.

cards.meaning: a part, a link (of a larger plan or program)
cards.defJa: 大きな計画や活動を形づくっている、つながりのある一つの部分。

passage.ja: ある市立中学校では、総合学習の一環として、生徒が地元の商店街の空き店舗を活用する計画を立てている。生徒たちは店主への聞き取りを重ね、客足が遠のいた理由を探った。その結果、週末だけ開く駄菓子屋を自分たちで運営する案がまとまり、市も実現に向けて協力することになった。
passage.en: At one municipal junior high school, as part of integrated studies, students are drawing up a plan to make use of empty shops in the local shopping street. The students interviewed shop owners again and again to find out why customers had stopped coming. As a result, they settled on a proposal to run a cheap-sweets shop themselves that opens only on weekends, and the city has agreed to cooperate in making it happen.

cards.meaning: list, table (for seeing things at a glance); a look over
cards.defJa: 多くの項目を、ひと目で見渡せるように並べたもの。

passage.ja: ある企業では、会議の録音を生成AIに読み込ませ、決まった事項や担当者、期限を一覧にまとめている。これまで若手社員が一時間かけていた議事録づくりが、数分で終わるようになった。ただし、AIは発言の意図を取り違えることもあるため、最後は必ず人が内容を確かめる決まりにしている。
passage.en: One company feeds its meeting recordings into generative AI and has it compile the decisions, the people responsible and the deadlines into a list. Writing up the minutes, which used to take junior staff an hour, now takes a few minutes. However, because the AI sometimes misreads the intent behind what was said, the company has a rule that a person always checks the content at the end.

cards.defJa: 始めから終わりまで、考え方ややり方が変わらないこと。

passage.ja: その画家は六十年以上にわたり、一貫して故郷の海だけを描き続けた。同じ浜辺でも、季節や時刻によって光の色はまったく違うというのが口癖だった。晩年の作品では波の形がしだいに消え、画面は青と灰色の色面だけになっていく。そこに、ひとつの主題を突き詰めた人の到達点を見る評論家も多い。
passage.en: For more than sixty years, the painter consistently painted nothing but the sea of his hometown. He was fond of saying that even on the same beach, the color of the light is completely different depending on the season and the time of day. In the late works the shapes of the waves gradually disappear, until the canvas holds nothing but fields of blue and gray. Many critics see in this the culmination of someone who pursued a single subject to the very end.

cards.defJa: 全体の中の、ある部分。全部ではないこと。

passage.ja: 一部の報道によると、政府は来年度から高校の授業料支援を所得に関係なく広げる方向で調整に入った。ただ、財源をどこから確保するかはまだ決まっていない。教育関係者の間では歓迎する声が多い一方、生徒が私立に流れ、公立高校の定員割れが進むのではないかと心配する意見もある。
passage.en: According to some media reports, the government has begun working toward expanding high-school tuition support from the next fiscal year regardless of income. However, where the funding will come from has not yet been decided. While many in education welcome the move, some worry that students will drift to private schools and leave more public high schools short of applicants.

cards.meaning: thorough, perfect, fully secure (leaving nothing to chance)
cards.defJa: 少しの手落ちもなく、完全であること。

passage.ja: 秋の山は天気が変わりやすく、晴れた朝でも午後には冷たい雨に変わることがある。山岳ガイドは、雨具や防寒着、ヘッドライトを必ず持ち、万全の準備で出かけるよう勧めている。また、日が短くなるため、遅くとも午後二時には下山を始める計画を立てておくと安心だという。
passage.en: In autumn the mountain weather changes easily, and even a sunny morning can turn to cold rain by the afternoon. Mountain guides advise always carrying rain gear, warm clothing and a headlamp, and setting out fully prepared. They also say that since the days are getting shorter, it is reassuring to plan to start the descent by 2 p.m. at the latest.

cards.defJa: 野球で、二番目の塁の次にあり、本塁の手前にある塁。

passage.ja: 九回裏、一点を追う場面で、先頭打者が右中間を破る長打を放った。打者は二塁を回っても足をゆるめず、頭から三塁に滑り込んだ。無死三塁という絶好の機会に、相手チームはたまらず投手を代えた。しかし続く打者が外野へ犠牲フライを打ち上げて同点に追いつくと、球場は総立ちの観客の歓声に包まれた。
passage.en: In the bottom of the ninth, trailing by one run, the leadoff batter hit a long drive through the right-center gap. Without easing up even after rounding second, he slid headfirst into third base. With a runner on third and nobody out—a golden chance for the batting side—the opposing team could not help but change pitchers. But when the next batter lofted a sacrifice fly to the outfield to tie the game, the ballpark was engulfed in cheers from a crowd on its feet.

cards.defJa: 野球で、打者がストライクを三つとられてアウトになること。

passage.ja: 先発した高卒二年目の投手は、最速百五十五キロの直球を武器に、六回までに十個の三振を奪った。特に、満塁のピンチで四番打者を空振り三振に仕留めた場面では、ベンチの選手たちが一斉に立ち上がった。監督は試合後、その成長に目を細めながらも、球数の多さを今後の課題に挙げた。
passage.en: The starting pitcher, in his second year out of high school, used a fastball that topped out at 155 km/h to rack up ten strikeouts through six innings. When he struck out the cleanup hitter swinging with the bases loaded, the players in the dugout all rose to their feet at once. After the game, the manager beamed at his growth but named his high pitch count as something to work on.

cards.meaning: listing (of shares on a stock exchange); going public
cards.defJa: 会社の株を証券取引所で売り買いできるようにすること。

passage.ja: 創業からわずか五年のこの宇宙関連企業は、早ければ来月にも東京証券取引所に株式を上場する予定だ。小型の人工衛星を安く打ち上げる技術が評価され、海外の投資家からも注目を集めている。上場で得た資金は、新しい工場の建設と技術者の採用に充てるという。
passage.en: This space company, founded just five years ago, plans to list its shares on the Tokyo Stock Exchange as early as next month. Its technology for launching small satellites cheaply has been well received, and it is drawing attention from overseas investors as well. The company says it will use the money raised through the listing to build a new factory and hire engineers.

cards.defJa: 映画などをスクリーンに映して、観客に見せること。

passage.ja: 市内の古い映画館で、半世紀前の名作を当時のフィルムのまま上映する催しが二日間にわたって開かれた。会場には往年のファンだけでなく、配信でしか映画を観たことのない若者の姿も目立った。映写機の回る音や映像のかすかなちらつきまでが、若い観客には新鮮に映ったようだ。
passage.en: At an old cinema in the city, a two-day event was held to screen a classic from half a century ago on its original film. The audience included not only longtime fans but also a noticeable number of young people who had only ever watched films through streaming. Even the whir of the projector and the faint flicker of the picture seemed fresh to the young viewers.

cards.meaning: upper reaches, upstream (of a river); upper class
cards.defJa: 川の、水が流れ出てくる源に近いほう。

passage.ja: この川の上流では、かつて家庭の排水が流れ込み、夏になると水が濁って悪臭を放っていた。住民が中心となって清掃活動を続け、下水道の整備も進んだ結果、ここ十年で水質は大きく改善した。いまでは清流にしか生息しないとされる魚の姿も、再び見られるようになっている。
passage.en: In the upper reaches of this river, household wastewater once poured in, and in summer the water turned murky and gave off a foul smell. Thanks to clean-up work led by residents and the expansion of the sewer system, water quality has improved greatly over the past ten years. Fish said to live only in clear streams can now be seen there once again.

cards.defJa: 文書などで、それより前に書いてあること。

passage.ja: 総務部から届いたメールの冒頭には、年末の大掃除の日時と場所が書かれていた。その下には「上記の日程で各自の机まわりを片付け、不要な書類は専用の箱に入れてください」と続いていた。個人情報を含む書類は通常のごみとして捨てず、必ずシュレッダーにかけるようにとも念を押していた。
passage.en: At the top of the email from the general affairs department were the date, time and place of the year-end office cleanup. Below that it read: 'Please tidy up around your own desk on the above date and put unneeded papers in the designated boxes.' It also stressed that documents containing personal information must not be thrown out with ordinary trash but always put through a shredder.

cards.meaning: upper part, top; higher-level (body or organization)
cards.defJa: 物の、上のほうの部分。

passage.ja: 新型ロケットの上部には、観測衛星を収めるための円筒形のカバーが取り付けられている。打ち上げの際、空気の抵抗や熱から衛星を守るのがその役目だ。大気圏をほぼ抜けた段階でカバーは二つに割れて外れ、中の衛星が姿を現す。外れたカバーは海に落ちるが、最近はこれを回収して再利用する試みも始まっている。
passage.en: Fitted to the upper part of the new rocket is a cylindrical cover that houses an observation satellite. Its job is to protect the satellite from air resistance and heat during launch. Once the rocket has nearly left the atmosphere, the cover splits in two and falls away, and the satellite inside comes into view. The discarded cover falls into the sea, but efforts to recover and reuse it have recently begun.

cards.defJa: 順位や地位が低いこと。

passage.ja: 昨年まで売り上げランキングで下位に低迷していた缶コーヒーが、今年に入って急に売れ始めた。きっかけは、甘さを抑えた新しい味に変えたことだ。健康を気にする中高年だけでなく、若い会社員にも支持が広がっている。メーカーは来春、同じ方針で紅茶の新商品も出す予定だという。
passage.en: A canned coffee that had languished near the bottom of the sales rankings until last year suddenly started selling well this year. The trigger was a switch to a new, less sweet flavor. Its popularity has spread not only among health-conscious middle-aged and older people but also among young office workers. The manufacturer reportedly plans to release a new tea product along the same lines next spring.

cards.defJa: 文書などで、このあとに書いてあること。

passage.ja: マンションの掲示板に、管理会社からのお知らせが貼り出された。給水管の点検のため、下記の日時に建物全体で断水するという内容だ。作業は午前中に終わる見込みだが、念のため前日のうちに飲み水やトイレ用の水をためておくよう呼びかけている。作業後しばらくは水が濁ることもあるため、少し流してから使うようにとの注意も添えられていた。
passage.en: A notice from the management company was put up on the apartment building's bulletin board. It said the water would be shut off throughout the building on the date and at the time given below, for an inspection of the supply pipes. The work is expected to be finished by midday, but residents are asked to store drinking water and water for the toilet the day before, just in case. It also added a caution that the water may be cloudy for a while after the work, so it should be run for a bit before use.

cards.defJa: 二つの議院がある議会で、上院に対するもう一方の議院。

passage.ja: 米国の議会は上院と下院の二つから成り、歳入法案は下院で発議する決まりになっている。下院議員の任期は二年と短く、全員が二年ごとに選挙で選ばれる。このため議員は常に地元の有権者の目を意識せざるを得ず、世論の変化が議会の勢力図に表れやすい。
passage.en: The U.S. Congress consists of two chambers, the Senate and the House of Representatives, and bills for raising revenue must originate in the House. Representatives serve short two-year terms, and all of them face election every two years. As a result, members can never stop thinking about how voters back home see them, and shifts in public opinion readily show up in the balance of power in Congress.

cards.meaning: insufficiency, failure (of an organ or function); incompleteness
cards.defJa: 働きや状態が十分でなく、きちんと機能しないこと。

passage.ja: 心不全は、心臓のポンプとしての働きが弱まり、全身に十分な血液を送れなくなる状態を指す。高齢化に伴って患者は増え続けており、専門家の間では心不全パンデミックという言葉まで使われている。息切れや足のむくみは初期の兆しとされ、早めに受診すれば悪化を防げることも多い。
passage.en: Heart failure refers to a condition in which the heart weakens as a pump and can no longer send enough blood around the body. Patient numbers keep rising as the population ages, and among specialists the phrase 'heart failure pandemic' has even come into use. Shortness of breath and swollen legs are considered early signs, and seeing a doctor early can often keep it from getting worse.

cards.defJa: いやな感じがして、気分がよくないこと。

passage.ja: 満員電車で他人と体が触れ合うと、多くの人は強い不快感を覚える。心理学では、人には他人に入ってほしくない見えない空間があり、それが侵されるとストレスを感じると説明される。この空間の広さは文化や相手との関係によって異なり、親しい人ほど近くにいても気にならない。
passage.en: When their bodies press against strangers' on a packed train, many people feel a strong sense of discomfort. Psychology explains that people have an invisible space around them that they do not want others to enter, and that they feel stress when it is invaded. The size of this space varies with culture and with one's relationship to the other person, and the closer someone is to us, the less we mind them being near.

cards.defJa: 法律に反していること。

passage.ja: 山あいの空き地に、古い家電やタイヤが大量に捨てられているのが見つかった。夜間にトラックで運び込まれたとみられ、県警は不法投棄の疑いで捜査を始めた。処分費用を浮かせようとする業者による犯行が多く、自治体は監視カメラを増やして対策を強めている。
passage.en: Large amounts of old appliances and tires were found dumped on a vacant lot in the hills. They are believed to have been brought in by truck at night, and the prefectural police have opened an investigation on suspicion of illegal dumping. Many such cases are committed by operators trying to save on disposal costs, and local governments are stepping up countermeasures by installing more surveillance cameras.

cards.defJa: 政権をになう政党と、それ以外の政党をまとめた呼び方。

passage.ja: 物価高への対策をめぐり、国会では与野党の論戦が続いている。与党は低所得世帯への給付金を柱とする案を示したが、野党は消費税の一時的な引き下げを強く求めている。双方の溝は深く、補正予算案の採決は来週以降にずれ込む見通しだ。年内の成立を目指す政府は、野党側との修正協議も視野に入れている。
passage.en: Debate between the ruling and opposition parties continues in the Diet over measures to deal with rising prices. The ruling party has put forward a plan centered on cash handouts to low-income households, but the opposition is pressing hard for a temporary cut in the consumption tax. The gap between the two sides is deep, and the vote on the supplementary budget is expected to slip to next week or later. The government, which wants it passed within the year, is also considering talks with the opposition on amendments.

cards.defJa: 話に出てきた二つの政党のどちらも。

passage.ja: インドの総選挙は有権者が九億人を超え、世界最大の民主主義の祭典とも呼ばれる。今回も与党と最大野党の二大政党が激しく競り合った。両党はいずれも農村部の票を重視し、農家への支援策や若者の雇用対策を競うように掲げた。一方、地域政党が議席を伸ばした州もあり、選挙後の連立の行方にも注目が集まった。
passage.en: India's general election, with more than 900 million voters, is sometimes called the world's biggest festival of democracy. This time, too, the two major parties, the ruling party and the largest opposition party, fought a fierce contest. Both parties put great weight on rural votes, vying with each other to promise support for farmers and jobs for young people. Meanwhile, regional parties gained seats in some states, and attention also turned to what coalition would emerge after the election.

cards.defJa: 右と左、二つの手。

passage.ja: 久しぶりに実家へ帰ると、祖母はゆっくりと玄関まで出てきて、私の手を両手でしっかりと包み込んだ。その手は昔よりひと回り小さく、少し冷たかった。言葉は多くなかったが、手のひらの温かさが少しずつ伝わってきて、離れて暮らした年月が埋まっていくような気がした。
passage.en: When I went back to my family home after a long time away, my grandmother came slowly out to the entrance and wrapped my hand firmly in both of hers. Her hands were a size smaller than they used to be, and a little cold. She did not say much, but as the warmth of her palms slowly came through, I felt as if the years we had spent apart were being filled in.

cards.meaning: both (persons); the two (named people), used respectfully
cards.defJa: 話題になっている二人の人を、敬意をこめて指す言い方。

passage.ja: 業界二位と三位の食品メーカーが、来年春に経営統合すると発表した。都内で開かれた記者会見には両社の社長がそろって出席し、固い握手を交わした。両氏はともに、国内市場の縮小に危機感を抱いていると述べ、海外展開を加速させる必要性を強調した。統合が実現すれば、売上高で業界首位に肩を並べる規模となる。
passage.en: The second- and third-largest food makers in the industry have announced that they will merge their operations next spring. The presidents of both companies attended a press conference in Tokyo together and shook hands firmly. Both said they felt a sense of crisis over the shrinking domestic market and stressed the need to accelerate overseas expansion. If the merger goes through, the combined company will be on a par with the industry leader in sales.

cards.defJa: 話題になっている二人、または二つの側。その双方。

passage.ja: 隣り合う二軒の住宅の間で、境界のブロック塀をめぐる争いが三年近く続いていた。一方は塀が自分の土地にはみ出していると主張し、もう一方は昔からその位置にあったと譲らなかった。裁判所は測量のやり直しを提案し、両者もこれを受け入れた。その結果をもとに話し合いが進み、ようやく和解が成立した。
passage.en: For nearly three years, a dispute over the concrete-block boundary wall had dragged on between two neighboring houses. One side claimed the wall protruded onto its land, while the other refused to budge, insisting it had always stood in that spot. The court proposed a new survey, and both parties accepted it. Talks then proceeded on the basis of the results, and a settlement was finally reached.

cards.meaning: row; line (of houses, shops, etc.); arrangement
cards.defJa: 物や建物が一列に続いている様子。また、その列。

passage.ja: 商店街の古い書店が閉店した翌月、同じ並びに小さなパン屋が開店した。朝七時から焼きたてのパンが店頭に出るため、通勤前に立ち寄る客で店先はいつもにぎわっている。向かいの喫茶店にも、パンを目当てに訪れた客が流れてくるようになり、売り上げが伸びたという。一軒の店が通り全体の空気を変えることもあるのだ。
passage.en: The month after the old bookstore in the shopping street closed, a small bakery opened in the same row. Because freshly baked bread comes out from seven in the morning, the storefront is always busy with customers stopping by on their way to work. Customers who came for the bread have also begun drifting into the café across the street, whose sales have reportedly risen. Sometimes a single shop can change the atmosphere of an entire street.

cards.defJa: 学校を卒業する前に、途中でやめること。

passage.ja: 大学を中退して起業する若者は、もはや珍しい存在ではない。在学中に始めたアプリ開発が軌道に乗り、学業との両立が難しくなったというケースが多い。一方で、事業がうまくいかなかった場合に、学歴の面で不利になるという不安もつきまとう。最近は休学制度を使い、退路を残したまま挑戦する学生も増えている。
passage.en: Young people who drop out of university to start a business are no longer a rarity. In many cases, an app they began developing while enrolled takes off, and balancing it with their studies becomes difficult. At the same time, there is the lingering worry that if the business fails, they will be at a disadvantage in terms of academic credentials. Recently, more students are using leave-of-absence systems to take the plunge while keeping a way back open.

cards.meaning: main force; mainstay; core (product, business or players)
cards.defJa: 全体の中で、中心となって働く力や部分。

passage.ja: 国内の大手家電メーカーが、長年の主力だったテレビ事業から撤退すると発表した。海外メーカーとの価格競争が激しくなり、ここ数年は赤字が続いていた。今後は空調機器や業務用の設備を新たな柱に据え、経営資源を集中させるという。かつて茶の間の主役だった看板商品の退場に、時代の移り変わりを感じる人も多いだろう。
passage.en: A major domestic electronics maker has announced that it will withdraw from the television business, long its mainstay. Price competition with overseas manufacturers had intensified, and the business had been in the red for several years. Going forward, the company says it will make air conditioning and commercial equipment its new pillars and concentrate its management resources there. Many people will likely feel the passing of an era in the exit of the flagship product that was once the centerpiece of the family living room.

cards.defJa: スポーツのチームで、選手たちをまとめる役の人。

passage.ja: 大学ラグビー部の新しい主将に、三年生のフォワードが選ばれた。部員たちの投票で決まったもので、本人は「技術よりも、苦しい時に声を出せる人間でありたい」と語った。昨季はけが人が相次ぎ、上位争いから早々に脱落した。チームをどう立て直すのか、新主将の手腕が問われる。
passage.en: A third-year forward has been chosen as the new captain of the university rugby club. The choice was made by a vote of club members, and he said, "More than technique, I want to be someone who can speak up when things get tough." Last season a string of injuries saw the team drop out of the title race early. The new captain's ability to rebuild the team will be put to the test.

cards.defJa: その分野で、多くの人が選んでいる中心的な考え方ややり方。

passage.ja: 支払いの手段は、ここ十年ほどで大きく変わった。かつては現金が主流だったが、今ではスマートフォンでの決済が若い世代を中心に広がっている。コンビニのレジでも、小銭を数える客の姿はめっきり減った。ただ、災害で停電が起きると電子決済は使えなくなるため、現金を少し持ち歩くよう呼びかける自治体もある。
passage.en: Means of payment have changed greatly over the past decade or so. Cash used to be the norm, but now smartphone payments are spreading, especially among younger generations. Even at convenience store registers, customers counting out coins have become a far rarer sight. However, because electronic payments become unusable when a disaster causes a power outage, some local governments urge people to carry a little cash.

cards.meaning: to embark on; to launch into (a new undertaking)
cards.defJa: 新しい仕事や問題の解決に、自分から進んで取りかかる。

passage.ja: 人口減少が進む地方の町で、役場が空き家の活用に本格的に乗り出した。所有者から建物を借り上げて改修し、移住を希望する家族に安い家賃で貸し出す仕組みだ。初年度は五軒の募集に対し、都市部から四十件を超える応募があった。担当者は「家が埋まれば、商店や学校にも人が戻ってくるはずだ」と期待を寄せる。
passage.en: In a rural town with a shrinking population, the town office has launched a full-scale effort to put vacant houses to use. Under the scheme, it leases buildings from their owners, renovates them and rents them at low cost to families hoping to move there. In the first year, more than forty applications came in from urban areas for five houses. The official in charge is hopeful: "If the houses fill up, people should come back to the shops and schools too."

cards.meaning: crew member; crew (of a plane, ship or train)
cards.defJa: 飛行機や船、列車などに乗って、運行や業務にあたる人。

passage.ja: 地方空港を離陸した国内線の旅客機で、エンジンの不具合を示す警告灯が点灯し、機体は出発地の空港に引き返した。約四十分後に無事着陸し、乗客と乗員合わせて百八十人にけがはなかった。航空会社によると、機長は異常に気づいた直後に管制官と連絡を取り、引き返すことを決めたという。同社は機体を詳しく点検し、原因を調べている。
passage.en: On a domestic passenger jet that had taken off from a regional airport, a warning light indicating an engine malfunction came on, and the aircraft turned back to its departure airport. It landed safely about forty minutes later, and none of the 180 passengers and crew were injured. According to the airline, the captain contacted air traffic control immediately after noticing the problem and decided to turn back. The airline is inspecting the aircraft thoroughly to determine the cause.

cards.defJa: 整っていた状態がくずれて、まとまりがなくなること。

passage.ja: 夜遅くまでスマートフォンを見る習慣は、睡眠の質を下げる大きな要因とされる。画面から出る光が眠りを促すホルモンの分泌を抑え、体内時計を後ろにずらしてしまうからだ。生活リズムの乱れが続くと、日中の集中力が落ちるだけでなく、気分の落ち込みにもつながりやすい。専門家は、寝る一時間前には画面から離れるよう勧めている。
passage.en: The habit of looking at a smartphone late into the night is considered a major factor in poor sleep quality. This is because the light from the screen suppresses the secretion of a hormone that promotes sleep and pushes the body clock later. If a disrupted daily rhythm continues, it not only lowers concentration during the day but also tends to lead to low moods. Experts recommend stepping away from screens an hour before bed.

cards.defJa: 物事が起こる前に、そのことを前もって知らせること。

passage.ja: 人気アニメの劇場版の予告映像が公開され、わずか一日で再生回数が五百万回を超えた。九十秒ほどの短い映像だが、新しい登場人物や印象的な主題歌の一部が盛り込まれている。ファンの間では、短い場面から物語の展開を読み解こうとする投稿が相次いだ。配給会社は、公開日の発表を来月に予定している。
passage.en: The trailer for the film version of a popular anime was released, and in just one day it was viewed more than five million times. The clip runs only about ninety seconds, but it packs in new characters and part of a memorable theme song. Among fans, there was a flood of posts trying to work out where the story is headed from the brief scenes. The distributor plans to announce the release date next month.

cards.defJa: 本番の大会に出る人を決めるために、前もって行う試合や審査。

passage.ja: 国際ピアノコンクールの予選が始まり、世界各地から集まった若手奏者が一人ずつ舞台に立った。持ち時間は二十分で、審査員は技術だけでなく、曲の解釈や音色の美しさにも耳を傾ける。今回は応募者が過去最多となり、本選に進めるのは三割ほどにとどまる見込みだ。緊張で指が震えたという奏者も、演奏を終えると晴れやかな表情を見せた。
passage.en: The preliminary round of an international piano competition has begun, and young performers from around the world took the stage one by one. Each has twenty minutes, and the judges listen not only for technique but also for the interpretation of the pieces and the beauty of the tone. This time the number of applicants was the highest ever, and only about thirty percent are expected to advance to the final round. Even performers who said their fingers had trembled with nerves looked bright and relieved once they finished playing.

cards.meaning: point at issue; key issue (in a dispute or election)
cards.defJa: 議論や選挙などで、意見が分かれて争いの中心となっている問題。

passage.ja: 来月の市長選挙では、老朽化した市民病院の建て替えが最大の争点となっている。現職は現在地での建て替えを主張し、新人は郊外への移転と規模の縮小を訴える。いずれの案も百億円を超える費用がかかるため、市の財政への影響を心配する声も強い。投票率がどこまで伸びるかも、選挙の行方を左右しそうだ。
passage.en: In next month's mayoral election, rebuilding the aging municipal hospital has become the biggest issue. The incumbent argues for rebuilding on the current site, while the newcomer calls for moving it to the suburbs and scaling it down. Since either plan would cost more than ten billion yen, there is also strong concern about the impact on the city's finances. How high turnout climbs also looks likely to sway the outcome of the election.

cards.defJa: 実際にあった、具体的な出来事や例。

passage.ja: 生成AIを業務に取り入れる企業が増える中、ある経済団体が会員企業の活用事例をまとめた報告書を公表した。議事録の要約や問い合わせへの一次対応など、比較的身近な用途が多くを占めた。一方で、誤った情報をそのまま顧客に伝えてしまった例も紹介されており、人による確認の重要性が強調されている。報告書は、導入前に社内のルールを定めるよう勧めている。
passage.en: As more companies bring generative AI into their operations, a business federation has published a report compiling examples of how its member companies are using it. Relatively familiar uses, such as summarizing meeting minutes and handling first-line responses to inquiries, made up the majority. On the other hand, the report also describes cases in which incorrect information was passed straight on to customers, underscoring the importance of human checking. The report recommends setting internal rules before adoption.

cards.defJa: 会社や役所などで、書類を作ったり整理したりする仕事。

passage.ja: 中小企業の多くでは、経理や総務の事務を少人数でこなしているのが実情だ。請求書の作成や交通費の精算など、細かい作業に追われて残業が増える職場も少なくない。最近はこうした作業を自動化するクラウドサービスが普及し、紙の書類を大幅に減らした会社もある。浮いた時間を顧客対応に回したことで、売り上げが伸びたという報告もある。
passage.en: At many small and medium-sized companies, the reality is that accounting and general administrative work is handled by just a few people. Quite a few workplaces see overtime pile up as staff are swamped with detailed tasks such as preparing invoices and settling travel expenses. Recently, cloud services that automate such tasks have become widespread, and some companies have drastically reduced their paper documents. There are also reports of sales rising after the time freed up was redirected to customer service.

cards.defJa: 野球で、一塁と三塁の間にある、二番目の塁。

passage.ja: 同点で迎えた九回裏、先頭打者が右中間を破る当たりで一気に二塁まで進んだ。続く打者が送りバントを決め、走者は三塁へ進んだ。一打サヨナラの場面に、スタンドの観客は総立ちになった。最後は代打の選手が初球をはじき返し、三時間を超える熱戦に決着がついた。
passage.en: In the bottom of the ninth with the score tied, the leadoff batter hit a ball that split the right-center gap and raced all the way to second base. The next batter laid down a sacrifice bunt, and the runner moved up to third. With a single hit able to end the game, the crowd in the stands rose to its feet. In the end, a pinch hitter lined the first pitch for a hit, settling a hard-fought game that had lasted more than three hours.

cards.defJa: 四年に一度開かれる、世界的なスポーツの大会。オリンピック。

passage.ja: 五輪の開催に名乗りを上げる都市は、かつてに比べて大きく減った。巨額の建設費や警備費が財政を圧迫し、大会後に使われなくなった競技場が負担として残る例が相次いだためだ。こうした批判を受け、国際オリンピック委員会は既存施設の活用を促し、複数都市での共同開催を認める方針に転じた。華やかな祭典をどう持続可能なものにするかが問われている。
passage.en: The number of cities bidding to host the Olympics has fallen sharply compared with the past. This is because huge construction and security costs have strained public finances, and there has been a string of cases in which stadiums left unused after the Games remained a burden. In response to such criticism, the International Olympic Committee has shifted to a policy of encouraging the use of existing facilities and allowing joint hosting by multiple cities. The question now is how to make this glittering festival sustainable.

cards.defJa: たくさんの人。世の中の多くの人たち。

passage.ja: 江戸の町では、人々は壊れた道具を簡単には捨てなかった。鍋の穴をふさぐ職人や、割れた茶碗を継ぐ職人が町を回り、古着や紙くずまで買い取る商売も成り立っていた。限られた資源を使い切る暮らしは、必要に迫られて生まれたものだった。それが現代の循環型社会の手本として見直されているのは興味深い。
passage.en: In the city of Edo, people did not casually throw away broken tools. Craftsmen who patched holes in pots and craftsmen who mended cracked tea bowls made their rounds of the town, and trades that bought up even old clothes and wastepaper could make a living. This way of life, in which limited resources were used to the last, was born out of necessity. It is interesting that it is now being reappraised as a model for today's circular society.

cards.defJa: ある仕事や組織にかかわる人の数。また、その人たち。

passage.ja: 年末の繁忙期を前に、大手の宅配会社が配達員などの人員を約一割増やすと発表した。ネット通販の広がりで荷物の量は年々増えており、現場の負担は限界に近いという。同社は短い時間だけ働ける仕組みを設け、主婦や学生にも応募を呼びかけている。それでも人手不足は深刻で、配達日の指定に制限をかける可能性もあるとしている。
passage.en: Ahead of the year-end busy season, a major parcel delivery company has announced it will increase its personnel, including delivery drivers, by about ten percent. With the spread of online shopping, parcel volumes rise year after year, and the burden on frontline staff is said to be near its limit. The company has set up a system that lets people work short hours and is calling on homemakers and students to apply. Even so, the labor shortage is severe, and the company says it may restrict customers' choice of delivery dates.

cards.defJa: 集まっている人や、ある集団に属する人の数。

passage.ja: 少子化が進む中、一クラスの人数を減らす「少人数学級」が全国の小学校で広がっている。教員が一人ひとりの理解度を把握しやすくなり、授業中に発言する子どもも増えたという報告がある。ただ、学級を増やせばそれだけ教員も必要になり、なり手不足に悩む自治体には重い負担だ。教室の数が足りず、図書室を転用した学校もある。
passage.en: As the birthrate falls, "small classes," which reduce the number of pupils per class, are spreading at elementary schools nationwide. There are reports that teachers find it easier to grasp each child's level of understanding and that more children speak up in lessons. However, more classes means more teachers are needed, a heavy burden for local governments already struggling to find recruits. Some schools without enough classrooms have converted their libraries.

cards.defJa: すべての人が生まれながらに持っている、人間らしく生きるための権利。

passage.ja: 外国人の働き手を受け入れる制度をめぐり、人権上の問題を指摘する声が国内外で上がっている。一部の職場では、パスポートを取り上げたり、長時間の残業に見合う賃金を払わなかったりする例が確認された。政府はこれを受けて制度を見直し、転職の自由を広げる方針を打ち出した。働く人の尊厳を守る仕組みを整えられるかどうかが、今後の課題となる。
passage.en: Voices pointing to human rights problems in the system for accepting foreign workers have been raised both at home and abroad. At some workplaces, cases were confirmed of employers confiscating passports and failing to pay wages commensurate with long hours of overtime. In response, the government reviewed the system and announced a policy of widening workers' freedom to change jobs. Whether it can put in place a framework that protects the dignity of working people will be the challenge ahead.

cards.defJa: 物や金ではなく、人に関係があること。

passage.ja: 大型の台風が九州を縦断し、各地で川の氾濫や土砂崩れが相次いだ。住宅の浸水は数千棟に上ったが、早めの避難が功を奏し、人的被害は最小限にとどまった。自治体は前日のうちに避難指示を出し、高齢者の移動には地域の消防団が付き添った。過去の災害の教訓が生かされた形だ。
passage.en: A large typhoon swept the length of Kyushu, causing a string of river floods and landslides in many areas. Several thousand homes were flooded, but early evacuation paid off, and human casualties were kept to a minimum. Local governments issued evacuation orders the day before, and members of local volunteer fire brigades accompanied elderly residents as they moved. It was a case of lessons from past disasters being put to good use.

cards.defJa: ほかにどうする方法もなく、あきらめるしかない。

passage.ja: 子どもの頃、雨で運動会が中止になると、私はなかなか納得できなかった。仕方ないと言われるたびに、大人はずいぶん簡単にあきらめるものだと腹を立てたものだ。けれども親になった今は、天気や子どもの体調のように、自分の力ではどうにもならないことがいかに多いかを知っている。あの言葉は、気持ちを切り替えるための小さな知恵だったのかもしれない。
passage.en: As a child, whenever sports day was canceled because of rain, I could never quite accept it. Every time I was told it couldn't be helped, I would get angry, thinking how easily grown-ups give up. But now that I am a parent myself, I know how many things, like the weather or a child's health, are beyond our control. Perhaps those words were a small piece of wisdom for helping us move on.

cards.meaning: others; another person (as distinct from oneself)
cards.defJa: 自分ではない、ほかの人。

passage.ja: 私たちは、自分のことは自分が一番よく知っていると考えがちだ。しかし実際には、話し方の癖や表情の変化など、他者の目を通してはじめて気づくことも少なくない。哲学の世界でも、自己は他者との関係の中で形づくられるという考え方が長く議論されてきた。人と向き合うことは、自分を知るための遠回りに見えて、実は近道なのかもしれない。
passage.en: We tend to think that we know ourselves better than anyone. In reality, however, there are quite a few things, such as habits in the way we speak or shifts in our expressions, that we notice only through the eyes of others. In philosophy, too, the idea that the self is formed through relationships with others has long been debated. Facing other people may look like a detour on the way to knowing ourselves, but it may in fact be a shortcut.

cards.meaning: tab; bill run up on credit; (fig.) consequences paid for later
cards.defJa: 品物の代金をその場で払わず、あとでまとめて払うこと。また、その代金。

passage.ja: 下町の小さな酒屋では、昔から常連客が代金をツケにして、月末にまとめて払う習慣があった。帳面には客の名前と日付、買った酒の銘柄が店主の字でびっしりと書き込まれている。電子決済が当たり前になった今でも、この店は近所の年配客に限ってツケを続けているという。顔の見える商売だからこそ成り立つ信用なのだと、店主は笑う。
passage.en: At a small liquor shop in an old downtown neighborhood, regulars have long had the custom of putting their purchases on a tab and settling up at the end of the month. The ledger is densely filled, in the owner's handwriting, with customers' names, dates and the brands of sake they bought. Even now that electronic payment is the norm, the shop reportedly still keeps tabs for elderly customers from the neighborhood, and only for them. It is a trust that works precisely because this is a business where everyone knows each other's faces, the owner says with a laugh.

cards.defJa: 物の表面に、ほかの物がくっついて離れないこと。

passage.ja: 新型コロナウイルスの流行をきっかけに、ウイルスが物の表面にどれくらい残るのかを調べる研究が相次いだ。ある研究チームの実験では、プラスチックやステンレスに付着したウイルスが、条件によっては数日間感染力を保つことが分かった。一方、紙や布の上では比較的早く感染力を失ったという。こまめな手洗いや消毒が勧められる背景には、こうした研究の積み重ねがある。
passage.en: The COVID-19 pandemic prompted a wave of research into how long viruses remain on the surfaces of objects. Experiments by one research team found that viruses clinging to plastic or stainless steel could, depending on conditions, remain infectious for several days. On paper or cloth, by contrast, they reportedly lost their infectivity relatively quickly. Behind the advice to wash hands and disinfect frequently lies this growing body of research.

cards.defJa: 本人の代わりに、仕事や手続きなどを行うこと。

passage.ja: 会社を辞めたいのに自分では言い出せない人に代わり、退職の意思を伝える「退職代行」サービスの利用が増えている。料金は数万円ほどで、依頼した翌日から出社しなくて済む場合も多い。上司に強く引き止められた経験や、職場の人間関係への不安が背景にあるとみられる。一方、企業の側からは、本人と直接話す機会がないまま別れることへの戸惑いも聞かれる。
passage.en: More and more people are using "resignation proxy" services, which convey the intention to quit on behalf of those who want to leave their companies but cannot bring themselves to say so. The fee is a few tens of thousands of yen, and in many cases clients no longer have to go into work from the day after they make the request. Behind this are thought to be experiences of being pressed hard by bosses to stay and anxiety about workplace relationships. Companies, for their part, voice bewilderment at parting ways without a chance to talk with the person directly.

cards.meaning: lying on one's back; face up
cards.defJa: 顔と胸を上に向けて横になった姿勢。

passage.ja: 腰の痛みに悩む人には、寝るときの姿勢を見直すよう勧める整形外科医が多い。仰向けで寝る場合は、膝の下に丸めたタオルを入れると、腰の反りが和らいで楽になるという。横向きが好きな人は、膝を軽く曲げて枕をはさむとよい。どの姿勢でも、体の一部に負担が集中しないようにすることが大切だ。
passage.en: Many orthopedic surgeons advise people suffering from lower back pain to review their sleeping posture. When sleeping on your back, placing a rolled-up towel under your knees reportedly eases the arch of the lower back and makes lying more comfortable. Those who prefer to sleep on their side should bend their knees slightly and hold a pillow between them. Whatever the posture, it is important not to let strain concentrate on one part of the body.

cards.meaning: arbitration; stepping in to settle a dispute
cards.defJa: 争っている人たちの間に入って、話をまとめ、争いをやめさせること。

passage.ja: 賃上げをめぐって労使の対立が続いていた地方の私鉄で、県の労働委員会による仲裁が行われた。組合側は物価高に見合う大幅な引き上げを求め、会社側は経営の厳しさを理由に応じていなかった。委員会は双方の言い分を聞いたうえで、中間に近い水準の裁定を下した。裁定には労使ともに従う義務があり、予定されていたストライキは回避された。
passage.en: At a regional private railway where labor and management had long been at odds over wage increases, the prefectural labor relations commission carried out arbitration. The union was demanding a substantial raise to match rising prices, while the company had refused, citing its tight finances. After hearing both sides' arguments, the commission handed down an award at a level close to the midpoint. Both labor and management are obliged to abide by the award, and the planned strike was averted.

cards.defJa: ある役職に就いて、その仕事を務める決まった期間。

passage.ja: 四年の任期を終える町長が、次の選挙には立候補しないと表明した。在任中は駅前の再開発や、子育て世帯への支援の拡充に取り組んできた。会見では「やり残したこともあるが、若い世代に町の将来を託したい」と語った。後継をめぐっては、すでに複数の町議が出馬の意向を示している。
passage.en: The town mayor, whose four-year term is coming to an end, has announced that they will not run in the next election. While in office, the mayor worked on redeveloping the area in front of the station and expanding support for households raising children. At a press conference, the mayor said, "There are things I've left undone, but I want to entrust the town's future to the younger generation." As for the succession, several town council members have already signaled their intention to run.

cards.meaning: chairman (of a company); president (of a society or association)
cards.defJa: 会社や団体で、いちばん上の立場にある人。会社では社長の上に置かれることが多い。

passage.ja: 創業から半世紀を迎えた食品メーカーで、社長を長く務めた創業者の長男が会長に退いた。新社長には生え抜きの専務が就任し、若手の登用を進める方針を打ち出している。会長は経営の細部には口を出さず、取引先との関係づくりに専念するという。社内では、世代交代が円滑に進むかどうかに注目が集まっている。
passage.en: At a food manufacturer marking half a century since its founding, the founder's eldest son, who had long served as president, stepped back to become chairman. A senior managing director who rose through the ranks has been appointed the new president and has set out a policy of promoting younger employees. The chairman reportedly will not meddle in the details of management and will concentrate on building relationships with business partners. Within the company, attention is focused on whether the generational change will go smoothly.

cards.meaning: slump; stagnation (of sales, prices, performance, etc.)
cards.defJa: 景気や成績などが悪い状態のまま、なかなかよくならないこと。

passage.ja: 国内の新車販売は、この数年低迷が続いている。若い世代の車離れに加え、半導体などの部品不足で納車が大幅に遅れたことも響いた。業界団体は来年には回復に転じると見込むが、物価高で消費者の財布のひもは固い。販売店の間では、先行きを楽観する声はまだ少ないのが現状だ。
passage.en: Domestic new-car sales have been in a slump for the past several years. On top of young people drifting away from cars, long delivery delays caused by shortages of semiconductors and other parts also took a toll. The industry association expects a turnaround next year, but with prices rising, consumers are keeping a tight grip on their wallets. Among dealers, few are yet optimistic about the outlook.

cards.meaning: resident; inhabitant (of a building or area)
cards.defJa: その家や建物、地域に住んでいる人。

passage.ja: 築五十年を超える団地で、住人の高齢化が急速に進んでいる。かつては子どもの声が絶えなかった広場も、今では昼間でも人影がまばらだ。そこで自治会は、空き部屋を学生に安く貸し出し、見守りや買い物の手伝いをしてもらう取り組みを始めた。若い住人が増えたことで、夏祭りも数年ぶりに復活したという。
passage.en: In a housing complex more than fifty years old, the residents are aging rapidly. The open square, once never without children's voices, is now nearly deserted even in the daytime. So the residents' association began renting vacant units cheaply to students and asking them to help with checking in on neighbors and shopping. With more young residents, the summer festival has reportedly been revived for the first time in several years.

cards.defJa: その時の体の具合。元気かどうかの状態。

passage.ja: 季節の変わり目は、気温差で体調を崩す人が多い。特に朝晩の冷え込みが厳しくなると、自律神経が乱れやすくなるとされる。専門家は、十分な睡眠と温かい食事に加え、入浴で体を芯から温めることを勧めている。少しでもだるさを感じたら、無理をせず早めに休むことが大切だ。
passage.en: When the seasons change, many people fall ill because of the swings in temperature. The autonomic nervous system is said to be especially prone to disruption when mornings and evenings turn sharply cold. Experts recommend not only getting enough sleep and eating warm meals but also warming the body to the core with a bath. If you feel even slightly sluggish, it is important not to push yourself and to rest early.

cards.meaning: what (esp. something unusual or alarming); everything (with a following 'also' particle)
cards.defJa: どんなこと。特に、何か変わったことや騒ぎ。

passage.ja: 深夜、家の前の通りが急に騒がしくなった。何事かと窓を開けると、消防車が三台、坂の上へ向かって走っていくところだった。近所の人たちも次々に外へ出てきて、不安そうに空を見上げている。近くの空き家のぼやで、幸いけが人もいなかったと分かったのは、一時間ほど後のことだった。
passage.en: Late at night, the street in front of the house suddenly became noisy. When I opened the window to see what was going on, three fire engines were racing up the hill. One after another the neighbors came outside too, looking anxiously up at the sky. It was about an hour later that we learned it had been a small fire at a vacant house nearby and that, fortunately, no one had been hurt.

cards.defJa: 数がとても多く、百の数倍にもなること。

passage.ja: 毎年冬になると、この湖には何百羽ものハクチョウが遠くシベリアから渡ってくる。朝日の中で一斉に飛び立つ姿を撮ろうと、夜明け前から岸辺には写真愛好家が並ぶ。ただ近年は暖冬の影響で、より北の地域で冬を越す群れが増え、ここまで飛来する数は少しずつ減っているという。地元の保護団体は、毎朝ハクチョウの数を数えて記録を続けている。
passage.en: Every winter, hundreds of swans fly to this lake all the way from Siberia. Photography enthusiasts line the shore from before dawn, hoping to capture the birds taking off all at once in the morning sun. In recent years, however, warmer winters have led more flocks to spend the season farther north, and the number reaching this lake is reportedly falling little by little. A local conservation group counts the swans every morning and keeps a running record.

cards.meaning: who; what kind of person (often someone unknown or suspicious)
cards.defJa: どういう人。正体のわからない人について言う。

passage.ja: 先月発売された長編小説が、ミステリー好きの間で話題になっている。物語は、山奥の旅館に届いた差出人不明の手紙から始まる。手紙を書いたのは何者なのか、読者は最後のページまで推理を楽しむことになる。作者は覆面作家で、その正体もまた謎に包まれたままだ。
passage.en: A full-length novel released last month has become a talking point among mystery fans. The story begins with an anonymous letter delivered to an inn deep in the mountains. Readers get to enjoy working out who on earth wrote the letter right up to the last page. The author writes anonymously, and who the author really is likewise remains shrouded in mystery.

cards.defJa: 大きな地震のあとに、その近くで続けて起こる地震。

passage.ja: 昨夜、県北部を震源とする最大震度5強の地震があった。揺れの強かった地域では、家具の転倒や屋根瓦の落下などの被害が出ている。その後も体に感じる余震が続いており、不安な一夜を避難所で過ごした住民も多い。気象庁は、今後一週間ほどは同じ程度の揺れに注意し、傾いた塀や崖には近づかないよう呼びかけている。
passage.en: Last night there was an earthquake centered in the northern part of the prefecture, registering a maximum seismic intensity of upper 5. In the areas that shook hardest, there has been damage such as toppled furniture and fallen roof tiles. Aftershocks strong enough to be felt have continued since, and many residents spent an anxious night in evacuation shelters. The Japan Meteorological Agency is urging people to stay alert for shaking of similar strength over the next week or so and not to go near leaning walls or cliffs.

cards.meaning: to build up; to create (something complete through sustained effort)
cards.defJa: 時間や手間をかけて、ものを最後まで完成させる。

passage.ja: 町の小さな劇団が、三年がかりで一本の舞台を作り上げた。脚本は、団員たちが地元の高齢者から聞き取った戦後の暮らしをもとにしている。衣装や大道具もすべて手作りで、稽古は仕事を終えた夜にしかできなかった。初日の幕が下りると、客席からはしばらく拍手が鳴りやまなかった。
passage.en: A small theater troupe in the town spent three years creating a single stage production. The script is based on postwar daily life as the members heard it from local elderly people. The costumes and sets were all handmade, and rehearsals could be held only at night after work. When the curtain fell on opening night, the applause from the audience went on for some time.

cards.meaning: to produce; to create; to generate
cards.defJa: 今までなかったものを、新しくこしらえる。生み出す。

passage.ja: 研究チームは、空気中の二酸化炭素と水から燃料を作り出す新しい装置を開発した。太陽光をエネルギー源とするため、運転中に温室効果ガスをほとんど出さないのが特徴だ。現時点では生産量がごく少なく、費用も既存の燃料の数倍にのぼる。それでもチームは、十年以内の実用化を目指して改良を続けるとしている。
passage.en: A research team has developed a new device that produces fuel from carbon dioxide in the air and water. Because it runs on sunlight, its defining feature is that it emits almost no greenhouse gases while operating. At present the output is tiny, and the cost is several times that of existing fuels. Even so, the team says it will keep improving the device, aiming for practical use within ten years.

cards.meaning: operation; activation (of a machine or device)
cards.defJa: 機械や装置が動いて、決められた働きをすること。

passage.ja: 高速道路で前の車との距離が急に縮まったとき、自動ブレーキが作動して追突を防いだ。こうした安全装置は、今や多くの新車に標準で備わっている。ただし、雨や霧でカメラの視界が悪いと、正しく働かない場合もある。メーカーは装置を過信せず、運転者が常に前方に注意を払うよう求めている。
passage.en: When the gap to the car ahead suddenly closed on the expressway, the automatic brakes kicked in and prevented a rear-end collision. Such safety systems now come as standard on many new cars. However, they may not work properly when the camera's view is obscured by rain or fog. Manufacturers ask drivers not to place too much faith in the systems and to keep their attention on the road ahead at all times.

cards.meaning: an average or normal year; usual (for the time of year)
cards.defJa: いつもの年。また、毎年決まってそうであること。

passage.ja: 今年は夏の猛暑の影響で、リンゴの収穫が例年より十日ほど遅れている。実が色づくには夜の気温が下がる必要があるが、九月に入っても暑い夜が続いたためだ。農家によると、味に大きな問題はないものの、日焼けして傷んだ実が目立つという。店頭に並ぶ量も、例年に比べてやや少なくなりそうだ。
passage.en: This year, because of the intense summer heat, the apple harvest is running about ten days later than usual. Apples need cooler nights to take on their color, but hot nights continued even into September. According to farmers, while there is no major problem with the taste, sunburned and damaged fruit is noticeable. The amount on store shelves also looks likely to be somewhat smaller than in a typical year.

cards.meaning: statement; testimony (to police or in court)
cards.defJa: 事件の容疑者や証人が、警察や裁判所で事実について話すこと。また、その内容。

passage.ja: 警察によると、逮捕された男は「生活費に困ってやった」と供述しているという。男は先月、市内のコンビニエンスストアで店員に刃物を突きつけ、現金を奪った疑いが持たれている。防犯カメラの映像などから男が浮上し、自宅近くで身柄が確保された。警察は、ほかにも同様の事件に関わっていないか調べている。
passage.en: According to police, the arrested man has stated, "I did it because I couldn't cover my living expenses." He is suspected of threatening a clerk at a convenience store in the city with a knife last month and stealing cash. He was identified from security camera footage and other evidence and taken into custody near his home. Police are investigating whether he was involved in other similar incidents.

cards.defJa: 他人の権利などを不当におかし、そこなうこと。

passage.ja: 人気アニメの映像を無断で動画サイトに投稿したとして、制作会社が投稿者を訴えた。会社側は、著作権の侵害によって数千万円の損害を受けたと主張している。こうした違法投稿は削除しても次々に現れ、いたちごっこが続いているのが実情だ。業界団体は、海外のサイト運営者とも協力して対策を強化する方針だ。
passage.en: A production company has sued a user for posting footage from a popular anime on a video site without permission. The company claims it suffered tens of millions of yen in damages through the copyright infringement. The reality is that such illegal uploads keep reappearing even after they are deleted, and the cat-and-mouse game goes on. The industry association plans to strengthen countermeasures, working with overseas site operators as well.

cards.defJa: 大切なものを、よい状態のまま守り続けること。

passage.ja: 干潟は多くの渡り鳥や貝類が暮らす、豊かな生態系を持つ場所だ。しかし高度成長期を中心に埋め立てが進み、国内の干潟は戦後およそ四割が失われたとされる。ある湾では、市民団体と漁協が協力して、残された干潟の保全に取り組んでいる。毎月の清掃活動には、親子連れを含め百人近くが参加している。
passage.en: Tidal flats are places with rich ecosystems where many migratory birds and shellfish live. But land reclamation, concentrated in the era of rapid economic growth, is estimated to have wiped out about 40 percent of the country's tidal flats since the war. In one bay, a citizens' group and the local fishing cooperative are working together to conserve the remaining flats. Close to a hundred people, including parents with their children, take part in the monthly cleanup.

cards.meaning: security; safety (maintenance of public safety and order)
cards.defJa: 社会や施設の安全と秩序を守ること。

passage.ja: 年末年始の帰省ラッシュを前に、空港の保安検査場では混雑が予想されている。手荷物に液体やモバイルバッテリーが入っていると、検査に時間がかかることが多い。航空会社は、時間に余裕を持って空港に着くよう利用者に呼びかけている。最近では、顔認証で手続きを短縮できるゲートを導入する空港も増えてきた。
passage.en: Ahead of the year-end and New Year homecoming rush, crowding is expected at airport security checkpoints. When carry-on bags contain liquids or power banks, inspections often take longer. Airlines are urging travelers to leave plenty of time to get to the airport. Recently, more airports have been introducing gates that use facial recognition to speed up the procedures.

cards.meaning: retention; holding (keeping something as it is)
cards.defJa: ある物や状態を、そのまま持ち続けること。

passage.ja: 対話型AIのサービスでは、利用者が入力した会話の内容を一定期間保持する仕組みが一般的だ。運営会社は、不正利用の監視やサービスの改善に役立てるためだと説明している。しかし、仕事の機密情報をうっかり入力してしまうと、外部に漏れるおそれも否定できない。そのため、社内での利用に独自のルールを設ける企業が増えている。
passage.en: With conversational AI services, it is common for the conversations users type in to be retained for a certain period. The operators explain that this helps them monitor misuse and improve the service. However, if you carelessly enter confidential work information, the possibility of it leaking outside cannot be ruled out. For that reason, more and more companies are setting their own rules for using these services internally.

cards.meaning: possession; holding (of assets, licenses, weapons, etc.)
cards.defJa: 財産や資格、権利などを自分のものとして持っていること。

passage.ja: 運転免許を保有する七十五歳以上の高齢者は、全国で数百万人に上る。高齢ドライバーによる事故が相次いだことをきっかけに、免許を自主的に返納する動きも広がった。一方、地方では車がなければ買い物にも病院にも行けないという声が根強い。自治体の中には、返納した人にタクシー券を配るなど、移動手段の確保に乗り出すところもある。
passage.en: People aged 75 and over who hold a driver's license number several million nationwide. A string of accidents involving elderly drivers also prompted a wave of voluntary license surrenders. In rural areas, on the other hand, many insist that without a car they cannot even get to the shops or the hospital. Some local governments have begun securing ways for people to get around, for example by handing out taxi vouchers to those who give up their licenses.

cards.defJa: 一人だけで使う部屋。

passage.ja: 入院すると、多くの場合は四人部屋や六人部屋に入ることになる。個室を希望すると、病院によっては一日数千円から数万円の差額ベッド代がかかる。それでも、周りに気を使わずに休めるため、利用を望む患者は少なくない。感染症の流行時には治療上の必要から個室に移されることもあり、その場合は費用を求められない。
passage.en: When you are admitted to hospital, in most cases you are placed in a four- or six-bed room. If you ask for a private room, depending on the hospital you may be charged a room supplement of anywhere from several thousand to tens of thousands of yen a day. Even so, quite a few patients want one because they can rest without worrying about the people around them. During outbreaks of infectious disease, patients are sometimes moved to private rooms out of medical necessity, and in that case they are not asked to pay.

cards.meaning: under the umbrella (of a parent company or organization); affiliated with
cards.defJa: 大きな会社や組織の下に入り、その支配や指導を受けていること。

passage.ja: 大手通信会社は、国内の老舗旅行会社を買収し、傘下に収めると発表した。旅行会社は長年、団体旅行を中心に業績を伸ばしてきたが、ネット予約の普及に対応しきれずにいた。通信会社は、自社の会員基盤やデータを生かして、新しい旅のサービスを展開する考えだ。旅行会社のブランド名は、当面そのまま残すという。
passage.en: A major telecommunications company has announced that it will acquire a long-established domestic travel agency and bring it under its umbrella. The travel agency had grown its business for years mainly through group tours, but had struggled to keep up with the spread of online booking. The telecom company plans to roll out new travel services by drawing on its membership base and data. The travel agency's brand name will reportedly be kept as it is for the time being.

cards.meaning: to hurt (someone's feelings); to wound; to damage
cards.defJa: 人の気持ちや体、物などをいためる。

passage.ja: 親しい間柄だからこそ、何気ない一言が相手を深く傷つけることがある。冗談のつもりで言った言葉でも、受け取る側の心には長く残る場合もある。心理学者によれば、大切なのは相手の反応に気づいたとき、すぐに謝ることだという。言い訳を重ねるよりも、素直に気持ちを伝えるほうが関係の修復につながりやすい。
passage.en: Precisely because two people are close, a casual remark can sometimes hurt the other person deeply. Even words meant as a joke may linger for a long time in the heart of the person on the receiving end. According to psychologists, what matters is apologizing right away when you notice the other person's reaction. Rather than piling up excuses, honestly conveying how you feel is more likely to help repair the relationship.

cards.meaning: injury; bodily harm (esp. in legal and insurance contexts)
cards.defJa: 体にけがをさせること。また、そのけが。

passage.ja: スキーやスノーボードに出かける前に、傷害保険に入っておく人が増えている。ゲレンデでの転倒や衝突によるけがは、骨折など治療が長引くケースも少なくない。最近はスマートフォンから一日単位で申し込める商品もあり、数百円で加入できる。他人にけがをさせた場合の賠償まで補償するものを選ぶと、より安心だ。
passage.en: More and more people are taking out injury insurance before they go skiing or snowboarding. Injuries from falls and collisions on the slopes are often ones like fractures, where treatment drags on. These days there are also policies you can apply for by the day from a smartphone, and you can sign up for a few hundred yen. Choosing one that also covers compensation if you injure someone else gives you more peace of mind.

cards.meaning: a little while ago; just now
cards.defJa: 少し前。「さっき」の丁寧な言い方。

passage.ja: 先ほどお電話でお伝えした件について、改めてメールでご連絡いたします。来週の打ち合わせは、ご都合に合わせて木曜日の午後二時からに変更いたしました。会場は前回と同じく、本社ビル七階の会議室です。資料は前日までにお送りしますので、お目通しいただけますと幸いです。
passage.en: I am following up by email on the matter I mentioned on the phone a little while ago. To fit your schedule, we have moved next week's meeting to 2 p.m. on Thursday. As last time, the venue is the conference room on the seventh floor of the head office building. We will send the materials by the day before, and we would be grateful if you could look them over.

cards.meaning: taking the lead (by scoring first); preemption; seizing the initiative
cards.defJa: 相手より先に行動して、有利な立場に立つこと。特に、試合で先に点を取ること。

passage.ja: 決勝戦は、前半十分に地元チームが先制する展開となった。右サイドからのクロスを、ゴール前に走り込んだ若手が頭で合わせた。しかし相手も後半に入って攻勢を強め、立て続けに二点を奪って試合をひっくり返した。地元チームは最後まで粘ったものの、あと一歩及ばなかった。
passage.en: In the final, the home team took the lead ten minutes into the first half. A young player who ran into the box headed in a cross from the right flank. But the opponents stepped up their attack after the break, scoring two goals in quick succession to turn the match around. The home team fought on to the end but fell just short.

cards.meaning: starting (in a game), esp. as the starting pitcher; setting off ahead of others
cards.defJa: 試合の始めから出場すること。また、ほかより先に出かけること。

passage.ja: プロ野球では、先発投手が試合の最後まで一人で投げ抜く完投が、年々珍しくなっている。球数が百球前後に達すると、好投していても交代させるのが当たり前になったためだ。肩やひじへの負担を抑え、長いシーズンを通して力を保ってもらう狙いがある。その分、試合の後半を任される救援投手の層の厚さが、勝敗を大きく左右するようになった。
passage.en: In professional baseball, the complete game, in which the starting pitcher throws the whole game alone, is becoming rarer year by year. That is because it has become standard to take a pitcher out once he reaches around 100 pitches, even if he is pitching well. The aim is to limit the strain on shoulders and elbows and keep pitchers effective throughout the long season. As a result, the depth of the relief pitchers entrusted with the late innings now does much to decide games.

cards.meaning: to be the first to do something; to lead the way (ahead of others)
cards.defJa: ほかの人やものより先に物事を行う。

passage.ja: この町は、全国に先駆けて、すべての小中学校の屋上に太陽光パネルを設置した。発電した電気は校舎で使うほか、災害で停電した際には避難所の電源にもなる。導入から五年がたち、電気代の削減効果は当初の見込みを上回っているという。最近では同じ仕組みを学ぼうと、各地の自治体から視察が相次いでいる。
passage.en: Ahead of the rest of the country, this town installed solar panels on the roofs of all its elementary and junior high schools. Besides being used in the school buildings, the electricity also powers evacuation shelters when a disaster knocks out the grid. Five years on, the savings on electricity bills have reportedly exceeded the original projections. Recently, officials from local governments around the country have been arriving one after another to study the same system.

cards.defJa: 名誉なことで、ほこらしく思うこと。

passage.ja: 長年にわたる絵本作りが評価され、ある作家が児童文学の賞を受けることになった。受賞の知らせを受けたとき、作家はまず「身に余る光栄です」と語った。デビューから三十年、子どもたちに読み継がれてきたことが何よりの喜びだという。次の作品では、祖父母と孫の世代をつなぐ物語に挑戦したいと意欲を見せた。
passage.en: In recognition of many years of making picture books, an author is to receive a children's literature award. On hearing the news, the author's first words were, "It is an honor far greater than I deserve." Thirty years after debuting, the author says the greatest joy is that the books have been read by one generation of children after another. The author expressed eagerness to take on, in the next book, a story linking the generations of grandparents and grandchildren.

cards.defJa: 一つの政党の内部。その政党の中。

passage.ja: 次の総裁選をめぐり、与党では早くも党内の駆け引きが活発になっている。現職への支持を表明する議員がいる一方で、若手を中心に世代交代を求める声も強まっている。焦点は、影響力の大きいベテラン議員たちがどの候補を推すかだ。対立が深まれば、来年の選挙にも影響しかねないとの懸念も出ている。
passage.en: With the next party presidential election approaching, maneuvering within the ruling party has already intensified. While some lawmakers have declared their support for the incumbent, calls for a generational change are also growing louder, mainly among younger members. The focus is on which candidate the influential veteran lawmakers will back. Concerns have also been raised that if the divisions deepen, they could affect next year's election.

cards.defJa: 政党のいちばん上に立つ代表者。

passage.ja: 選挙戦を前に、各党の党首がそろう討論会がテレビで生中継された。物価高への対策や社会保障の財源をめぐって、激しい議論が交わされた。ただ、具体的な数字を示さず、互いの批判に終始する場面も目立った。視聴者からは、もっと政策の中身を比べられる形にしてほしいとの声が上がっている。
passage.en: Ahead of the election campaign, a debate bringing together the leaders of all the parties was broadcast live on television. Heated arguments were exchanged over measures against rising prices and how to fund social security. However, there were also many moments when the leaders offered no concrete figures and did nothing but criticize one another. Viewers have called for a format that would let them compare the substance of the policies more closely.

cards.meaning: entry; onset (of a season or period, esp. in compounds); attendance or turnout
cards.defJa: ある季節や時期が始まること。また、会場などに人が集まる具合。

passage.ja: 気象庁は二日、関東地方が梅雨入りしたとみられると発表した。平年より五日早く、去年と比べると十日以上早い。今後一週間は前線の影響で、曇りや雨の日が多くなる見込みだという。田植えを終えた農家にとっては恵みの雨だが、大雨による土砂災害には十分な注意が必要だ。
passage.en: On the 2nd, the Japan Meteorological Agency announced that the Kanto region appears to have entered the rainy season. That is five days earlier than average and more than ten days earlier than last year. Over the coming week, a seasonal front is expected to bring more cloudy and rainy days. For farmers who have finished planting rice it is a welcome rain, but people need to stay alert to landslides caused by heavy downpours.

cards.defJa: 建物や場所などへ入るための所。

passage.ja: その鍾乳洞の入り口は、国道から細い山道を十分ほど登った先にある。岩の割れ目のような狭い穴で、案内板がなければ見落としてしまいそうだ。一歩足を踏み入れると、夏でも気温は十五度ほどに下がり、ひんやりとした空気が肌を包む。奥へ進むにつれて天井は高くなり、やがて巨大な地下空間が姿を現す。
passage.en: The entrance to the limestone cave lies about ten minutes' climb up a narrow mountain path from the national highway. It is a cramped opening like a crack in the rock, and without the signboard you might well miss it. Once you step inside, the temperature drops to around fifteen degrees even in summer, and cool air envelops your skin. As you go deeper the ceiling rises, and eventually a huge underground space comes into view.

cards.meaning: to get into; to work one's way deep inside
cards.defJa: 中のほうまで深く入っていく。

passage.ja: スマートフォンの故障で意外に多いのが、充電端子の不具合だ。ポケットの中の糸くずやほこりが少しずつ端子の奥に入り込み、ケーブルを差しても接触しなくなる。ある修理店によると、持ち込まれる端末の一割近くがこの原因だという。細いブラシなどでそっとかき出すだけで直る場合も少なくない。
passage.en: A surprisingly common cause of smartphone trouble is a faulty charging port. Lint and dust from pockets gradually work their way deep into the port, until the cable no longer makes contact when it is plugged in. According to one repair shop, this is the cause in nearly one in ten of the devices brought in. In many cases, simply scraping it out gently with a thin brush is enough to fix it.

cards.defJa: 野球チームや劇団などの集まりに加わり、その一員になること。

passage.ja: 高校野球で活躍した投手が、ドラフト会議で一位指名を受けた地元球団への入団を決めた。会見では、子どもの頃からスタンドで応援してきたチームのユニホームを着られる喜びを語った。契約金は推定で一億円、背番号は18に決まった。まずは二軍で体づくりに取り組み、一年目からの一軍登板を目指すという。
passage.en: A pitcher who starred in high-school baseball has decided to join his local club, which picked him first in the draft. At the press conference he spoke of his joy at being able to wear the uniform of the team he had cheered for from the stands since childhood. His signing bonus is estimated at 100 million yen, and his uniform number has been set at 18. He says he will first work on building up his body with the farm team, aiming to pitch for the top team in his first year.

cards.meaning: moving in (to a home); taking up residence
cards.defJa: 新しい家や部屋に移り住むこと。

passage.ja: 郊外の大規模な団地で、空き部屋を学生向けに安く貸し出す取り組みが始まった。住民の高齢化が進み、かつて満室だった棟でも三割近くが空いているという。入居した学生には、月に数時間、地域の清掃や見守り活動に参加することが求められる。家賃の負担が軽くなるうえ、お年寄りとの交流も生まれると好評だ。
passage.en: At a large suburban housing complex, a scheme has begun to rent out vacant flats cheaply to students. As the residents have aged, nearly 30 percent of the units are said to be empty even in buildings that were once fully occupied. Students who move in are asked to take part in local cleaning and neighborhood-watch activities for a few hours a month. The scheme is popular because it lightens the rent burden and also creates contact with elderly residents.

cards.meaning: the whole area; the entire region
cards.defJa: ある地域や範囲のすべての部分。

passage.ja: 気象庁によると、今週末は強い寒気が流れ込み、北陸地方のほぼ全域で大雪となるおそれがある。山沿いでは一日に一メートルを超える降雪も予想され、高速道路の通行止めや鉄道の運休が相次ぐ可能性が高い。不要不急の外出を控え、車で出かける場合は冬用タイヤやチェーンを必ず用意するよう呼びかけている。
passage.en: According to the Japan Meteorological Agency, a strong mass of cold air will flow in this weekend, and there is a risk of heavy snow across almost the entire Hokuriku region. Along the mountains more than a meter of snow is forecast in a single day, and a string of expressway closures and train cancellations is likely. The agency is urging people to avoid non-essential outings and, if they drive, to be sure to have winter tires or chains.

cards.meaning: the full picture; the whole of something
cards.defJa: ものごとの全体の姿や内容。

passage.ja: 長年、一部しか調べられていなかった古代の都の跡で、大規模な発掘調査が行われている。最新の地中レーダーを使った探査により、宮殿を中心に碁盤の目のように道路が走る都市の全容が初めて明らかになった。研究チームは、当時の人口が数万人に達していた可能性があるとみている。今後は住居跡の分析を進め、人々の暮らしぶりに迫る方針だ。
passage.en: Large-scale excavations are under way at the site of an ancient capital that for years had been only partly studied. Surveys using the latest ground-penetrating radar have revealed for the first time the full layout of a city in which roads run in a grid pattern centered on the palace. The research team thinks the population at the time may have reached tens of thousands. It now plans to analyze the remains of dwellings and get closer to how people actually lived.

cards.defJa: 火事で建物などがすっかり焼けてしまうこと。

passage.ja: 二十八日未明、住宅街にある木造二階建ての民家から火が出て、約百平方メートルが全焼した。住人の夫婦は煙に気づいて外に逃げ出し、けがはなかった。火は隣の住宅の外壁の一部も焦がしたが、約二時間後に消し止められた。警察と消防が出火の原因を詳しく調べている。
passage.en: In the early hours of the 28th, a fire broke out at a two-story wooden house in a residential area, and about 100 square meters burned down completely. The couple who live there noticed the smoke and escaped outside unharmed. The fire also scorched part of the outer wall of the house next door but was put out about two hours later. Police and firefighters are investigating the cause in detail.

cards.meaning: all of the United States; nationwide (US)
cards.defJa: アメリカ合衆国の全体。

passage.ja: 公開されたばかりの日本のアニメ映画が、全米の興行収入ランキングで初登場一位を獲得した。字幕版にもかかわらず、公開初週末だけで約二千万ドルを売り上げたという。現地の映画館では、上映後に観客から拍手が起こる光景も見られた。配給会社は上映館数をさらに増やす方針だ。
passage.en: A Japanese animated film that had only just been released debuted at number one in the nationwide US box-office rankings. Despite being shown with subtitles, it reportedly took about 20 million dollars in its opening weekend alone. In cinemas there, audiences were even seen breaking into applause after screenings. The distributor plans to increase the number of theaters showing it still further.

cards.defJa: 鉄道やバスなどの路線のすべての区間。

passage.ja: 台風の影響で運転を見合わせていた在来線が、三日ぶりに全線で運転を再開した。沿線では土砂崩れで線路が埋まった区間もあり、復旧作業は夜を徹して続けられた。朝の駅には通学の高校生や通勤客の姿が戻り、ホームには安堵の表情が広がった。ただし当面は、本数を減らした臨時ダイヤで運行するという。
passage.en: A conventional rail line that had suspended service because of the typhoon resumed operation along its entire length for the first time in three days. In some sections along the route landslides had buried the tracks, and repair work went on through the night. High-school students and commuters were back at the stations in the morning, and relief spread across faces on the platforms. For the time being, however, trains will run on a temporary timetable with fewer services.

cards.defJa: ものの端から端までの長さ。

passage.ja: 北海道の地層から見つかった恐竜の化石について、研究チームは新種であると発表した。ほぼ全身の骨格がそろっており、全長は約八メートルと推定される。くちばしのような口の形から、水辺の植物を主に食べていたと考えられている。保存状態がきわめて良く、恐竜の進化を知る上で貴重な手がかりになるという。
passage.en: A research team has announced that a dinosaur fossil found in rock strata in Hokkaido belongs to a new species. Almost the entire skeleton is intact, and its total length is estimated at about eight meters. From the beak-like shape of its mouth, it is thought to have fed mainly on plants near water. The fossil is extremely well preserved and is said to offer a valuable clue to understanding dinosaur evolution.

cards.defJa: すべての面。また、ある事柄のすべてにわたること。

passage.ja: この春から、市内の飲食店は原則として全面禁煙となった。これまで喫煙席を設けていた居酒屋の中には、客が減るのではないかと心配する声もあった。しかし半年がたった今、たばこの煙を嫌って足が遠のいていた家族連れが戻り、売り上げはむしろ増えたという店も多い。店員の健康を守る効果も期待されている。
passage.en: Since this spring, restaurants and bars in the city have in principle gone completely smoke-free. Some izakaya that had offered smoking seats worried that they would lose customers. But now, six months on, many establishments say that families who had stayed away because of the tobacco smoke have come back, and that sales have actually risen. The rule is also expected to help protect the health of staff.

cards.defJa: 刑事事件で、公開の法廷で行われる裁判の手続き。

passage.ja: 巨額の詐欺事件で起訴された元会社社長の初公判が、東京地方裁判所で開かれた。被告は起訴内容の一部を否認した。検察側は冒頭陳述で、被告が架空の投資話で全国の約二千人から資金を集めていたと指摘した。傍聴席には被害者とみられる人々の姿も多く、法廷は張りつめた空気に包まれた。
passage.en: The first hearing in the trial of a former company president indicted over a massive fraud case was held at the Tokyo District Court. The defendant denied part of the charges. In its opening statement, the prosecution said the defendant had collected money from about 2,000 people across the country with fictitious investment schemes. Many people believed to be victims were in the public gallery, and the courtroom was filled with tension.

cards.defJa: 隠しごとや不正がなく、正しく公平であること。

passage.ja: 来月の市長選挙を前に、選挙管理委員会は駅前で啓発活動を行った。職員たちは、買収や違法な寄付のない公明な選挙の実現を訴えるチラシを通行人に配った。前回の投票率は四割を切っており、特に若い世代の関心の低さが課題となっている。委員会は期日前投票の場所を大学の構内にも設ける予定だ。
passage.en: Ahead of next month's mayoral election, the election commission held an awareness campaign in front of the station. Staff handed passers-by leaflets calling for a fair, clean election free of vote-buying and illegal donations. Turnout last time fell below 40 percent, and the lack of interest among younger voters in particular is a problem. The commission plans to set up an early-voting station on a university campus as well.

cards.defJa: 国や自治体など、おおやけに関わるさま。

passage.ja: 物価の上昇が続く中、公的年金だけで生活を支えるのは難しくなっている。ある調査では、高齢者世帯の半数以上が、貯蓄を取り崩しながら暮らしていると答えた。専門家は、年金の給付水準を見直すとともに、高齢者が無理なく働き続けられる環境を整えることが欠かせないと指摘する。
passage.en: With prices continuing to rise, it is becoming hard to live on the public pension alone. In one survey, more than half of elderly households said they were getting by while drawing down their savings. Experts point out that, along with reviewing pension benefit levels, it is essential to create an environment in which older people can keep working without strain.

cards.defJa: 社会全体のためになる利益。

passage.ja: 著名人の私生活をどこまで報じてよいのかは、報道機関が常に向き合ってきた問題だ。判断の基準となるのは、その情報が公益にかなうかどうかである。たとえば政治家の資金の流れは国民が知るべき事柄だが、家族の病気まで伝える必要はないだろう。好奇心を満たすことと、社会の役に立つことは同じではない。
passage.en: How far it is acceptable to report on the private lives of public figures is a question news organizations have always had to face. The criterion is whether the information serves the public interest. A politician's flow of funds, for example, is something citizens ought to know, but there is surely no need to report on illnesses in their family. Satisfying curiosity and being of use to society are not the same thing.

cards.meaning: official announcement (esp. of a national election)
cards.defJa: 国などが、決めたことを広く一般に知らせること。特に選挙の始まりを正式に知らせること。

passage.ja: 参議院議員選挙が四日に公示され、十七日間の選挙戦が始まった。全国の選挙区と比例代表に、合わせて三百人を超える候補者が立候補を届け出た。物価高への対策や社会保障のあり方が主な争点となる見通しだ。各党の党首は初日から街頭に立ち、有権者に支持を訴えた。
passage.en: The House of Councillors election was officially proclaimed on the 4th, and a 17-day campaign began. More than 300 candidates in total registered to run in constituencies across the country and in proportional representation. Measures against high prices and the shape of social security are expected to be the main issues. Party leaders were out on the streets from the first day, appealing to voters for support.

cards.defJa: 国や自治体がお金を出して作った、公共の事業を行う法人。

passage.ja: かつて日本の電話事業は、国が全額を出資する公社によって運営されていた。加入の申し込みから電話がつながるまで、何か月も待たされることも珍しくなかったという。一九八五年に民営化されると、新しい会社の参入が認められ、料金の値下げやサービスの多様化が一気に進んだ。この改革は、その後の通信業界の姿を大きく変えた。
passage.en: Japan's telephone business was once run by a public corporation wholly funded by the state. It was reportedly not unusual to wait months between applying for a line and having the phone connected. When it was privatized in 1985, new companies were allowed to enter the market, and price cuts and a diversification of services advanced rapidly. The reform greatly changed the shape of the telecommunications industry that followed.

cards.defJa: 選挙などで、政党や候補者が人々に対して約束すること。また、その約束。

passage.ja: 新しく就任した市長は、選挙で掲げた公約のとおり、来年度から小中学校の給食費を無償にすると発表した。必要な費用は年間およそ十億円にのぼり、ほかの事業の見直しで財源を確保するという。子育て世帯からは歓迎の声が上がる一方、財政への影響を心配する意見も出ている。
passage.en: The newly inaugurated mayor announced that, in line with the pledge made during the election, school lunches at elementary and junior high schools will be free from next fiscal year. The cost will come to about one billion yen a year, and the funds will be found by reviewing other projects. While households raising children have welcomed the move, some have voiced concern about the impact on the city's finances.

cards.defJa: 多くの人が見たり使ったりできるようにすること。

passage.ja: 国内の研究機関が、日本語に特化した大規模言語モデルを無料で公開した。誰でもダウンロードして改良できるため、企業や大学での活用が広がると期待されている。開発チームは、学習に使ったデータの種類や評価結果も詳しく示した。中身が分からない海外製のモデルに頼らずに済む点を評価する声も多い。
passage.en: A domestic research institute has released, free of charge, a large language model specialized for Japanese. Because anyone can download and improve it, its use is expected to spread at companies and universities. The development team also set out in detail the kinds of data used for training and the evaluation results. Many people welcome the fact that it means no longer having to rely on foreign-made models whose inner workings are unknown.

cards.defJa: 二つ以上の団体がいっしょに行事などを開くこと。

passage.ja: 市の美術館と地元の新聞社の共催で、江戸時代の浮世絵を集めた展覧会が開かれている。海外の美術館から里帰りした作品も多く、国内で展示されるのは百年ぶりというものも含まれる。会場には平日でも長い列ができ、来場者は鮮やかな色彩に見入っていた。会期は来月末までだ。
passage.en: An exhibition of Edo-period ukiyo-e prints is being held, co-organized by the city art museum and a local newspaper. Many of the works have come home from museums abroad, including some being shown in Japan for the first time in a hundred years. Long lines form at the venue even on weekdays, and visitors gazed intently at the vivid colors. The exhibition runs until the end of next month.

cards.defJa: 一つのものを、二人以上で持ったり使ったりすること。

passage.ja: 在宅勤務が広がるにつれ、職場の情報をどう共有するかが大きな課題になった。ある会社では、会議の記録や作業の進み具合をすべて一つのオンライン文書にまとめるようにした。以前は担当者に聞かなければ分からなかったことも、今では誰でもすぐに確認できる。その結果、確認のためだけの打ち合わせが半分に減ったという。
passage.en: As remote work spread, how to share information in the workplace became a major issue. One company began gathering all its meeting records and the progress of every task into a single online document. Things that used to be unknowable without asking the person in charge can now be checked by anyone right away. As a result, meetings held just to confirm things have reportedly been cut in half.

cards.meaning: joint struggle; joining forces (against a common opponent)
cards.defJa: 二つ以上の団体が力を合わせて、共通の相手とたたかうこと。

passage.ja: 今年の春の賃上げ交渉では、業界の異なる労働組合が共闘する動きが目立った。物価上昇に賃金が追いつかない中、組合どうしが要求額や交渉の日程を合わせ、一体となって経営側に迫ったのだ。その結果、大手企業の多くで三十年ぶりの高い水準の回答が相次いだ。この流れが中小企業にも広がるかが注目される。
passage.en: In this year's spring wage negotiations, labor unions from different industries were notably joining forces. With wages failing to keep up with rising prices, the unions aligned their demands and negotiating schedules and pressed management as one. As a result, many large companies one after another offered raises at their highest levels in 30 years. Attention now turns to whether this trend will spread to small and medium-sized firms.

cards.defJa: ものの中のほう。また、ある線や境目より中の部分。

passage.ja: 駅のホームでは、電車が近づくと、黄色い線の内側に下がるよう求める放送が流れる。この線の正体は、目の不自由な人のための点字ブロックだ。表面の突起を足の裏や白いつえで確かめることで、ホームの端がどこにあるかが分かる。荷物を置いたり立ち止まったりして、ブロックをふさがないよう心がけたい。
passage.en: On station platforms, when a train approaches, an announcement asks people to step back behind the yellow line. That line is in fact tactile paving for people with visual impairments. By feeling the raised bumps on its surface with the soles of their feet or a white cane, they can tell where the edge of the platform is. We should take care not to block it by putting luggage down or stopping on it.

cards.defJa: 国の内部の政治や行政に関する仕事。

passage.ja: 戦前の日本で、警察や地方行政、選挙などを広く担っていたのが内務省である。県知事も選挙で選ばれるのではなく、内務省が任命した官僚が務めていた。その強大な権限は、思想の取り締まりにも使われた。戦後、民主化を進める中で同省は解体され、その仕事はいくつもの省庁に分けて引き継がれた。
passage.en: In prewar Japan, it was the Home Ministry that held broad responsibility for the police, local administration, elections and more. Prefectural governors, too, were not elected but were bureaucrats appointed by the Home Ministry. Its enormous powers were also used to suppress dissenting thought. After the war, as democratization went ahead, the ministry was dismantled and its work was divided up among several ministries and agencies.

cards.defJa: 野球で、四つのベースを結んだ線の中とその近く。また、そこを守る選手。

passage.ja: 九回裏、二死満塁の場面で打席に立った代打の選手は、初球を思い切り振り抜いた。打球は鋭いゴロとなって内野を抜け、二人の走者が生還して逆転サヨナラ勝ちとなった。ベンチから選手たちが一斉に飛び出し、球場は大きな歓声に包まれた。チームはこの勝利で、首位との差を一ゲームに縮めた。
passage.en: In the bottom of the ninth, with two out and the bases loaded, the pinch hitter who came to the plate swung hard at the first pitch. The ball shot through the infield as a hard grounder, two runners scored, and the team won with a come-from-behind walk-off. The players poured out of the dugout all at once, and the ballpark erupted in cheers. With the win, the team cut its gap to first place to one game.

cards.defJa: 人の心の中。性格や気持ちなど、外から見えない部分。

passage.ja: 人は相手の内面を、思っている以上に外見から判断している。心理学の実験では、見知らぬ人の顔写真をわずか0.1秒見せただけで、参加者はその人が信頼できるかどうかを答えることができた。しかも、時間をかけて見た場合とほとんど評価が変わらなかったという。第一印象がなかなか覆らないのは、このためかもしれない。
passage.en: People judge others' inner selves from their appearance far more than they realize. In psychology experiments, participants shown a photo of a stranger's face for just a tenth of a second were able to say whether that person seemed trustworthy. Moreover, their ratings barely differed from those given when they had time to look properly. This may be why first impressions are so hard to overturn.

cards.defJa: もう一度。ふたたび。

passage.ja: ネット銀行の多くは、不正なログインを防ぐために二段階の認証を取り入れている。パスワードを入力したあと、スマートフォンに届く六桁の数字を打ち込まなければ、口座にはアクセスできない。数字には有効期限があり、時間内に入力できなかった場合は再度送信を依頼する必要がある。手間はかかるが、被害を防ぐ効果は大きい。
passage.en: Many online banks have introduced two-step authentication to prevent unauthorized logins. After entering your password, you cannot access your account unless you type in a six-digit number sent to your smartphone. The number expires after a set time, and if you fail to enter it in time you have to ask for it to be sent again. It is a bit of a hassle, but it is very effective at preventing fraud.

cards.defJa: 止まっていたことを、また始めること。

passage.ja: 新型コロナウイルスの影響で中止が続いていた夏祭りが、四年ぶりに再開された。初日の夜には、コロナ禍前を上回る約十万人の見物客が通りを埋め尽くした。地元の商店街では、久しぶりの人出に店主たちも顔をほころばせていた。神輿の担ぎ手の数も、若い世代の参加で以前の水準に戻りつつあるという。
passage.en: A summer festival that had been canceled year after year because of the coronavirus pandemic was held again for the first time in four years. On the first night, about 100,000 spectators, more than before the pandemic, filled the streets. In the local shopping arcade, shop owners were all smiles at the first big crowds in a long time. The number of people carrying the portable shrines is also returning to former levels thanks to the participation of younger people.

cards.defJa: 冬の時期。冬の間。

passage.ja: 標高二千メートルを超える峠を通るこの山岳道路は、毎年十一月から翌年四月まで冬季閉鎖となる。積雪が五メートルに達する場所もあり、除雪だけでも一か月以上かかるからだ。春の開通直後には、道の両側にそびえる雪の壁の間を車で走ることができ、多くの観光客が訪れる。
passage.en: This mountain road, which runs over a pass more than 2,000 meters above sea level, is closed for the winter every year from November until April of the following year. In places the snow reaches five meters deep, so clearing it alone takes more than a month. Right after it reopens in spring you can drive between towering walls of snow on both sides of the road, and many tourists come to do so.

cards.defJa: 船が港を出ていくこと。

passage.ja: 南極観測船が、乗組員の家族や関係者に見送られて東京を出港した。観測隊員の多くは後から飛行機でオーストラリアに向かい、寄港地で船に乗り込む。そこから約一か月かけて、日本の観測基地を目指す。船には、隊員の一年あまりの暮らしを支える食料や燃料など、約千トンの物資が積み込まれている。
passage.en: The Antarctic research ship set sail from Tokyo, seen off by the crew's families and officials. Most of the expedition members will fly to Australia later and board the ship at its port of call there. From there it will take about a month to reach Japan's research station. The ship is loaded with about 1,000 tons of supplies, including the food and fuel that will sustain the members for more than a year.

cards.meaning: outbreak of fire; a fire starting (in a building)
cards.defJa: 建物などから火が出て、火事が起こること。

passage.ja: 昨夜十一時ごろ、市内の住宅街にある木造二階建ての民家から出火し、約二時間後に消し止められた。住人の夫婦は煙に気づいてすぐに外へ逃げ、けが人はいなかった。消防によると、一階の台所付近の燃え方が激しく、火元とみられている。警察と消防は、コンロの消し忘れがなかったか詳しく調べている。
passage.en: At around 11 last night, a fire broke out at a two-story wooden house in a residential area of the city and was put out about two hours later. The couple who lived there noticed the smoke and fled outside at once, and no one was injured. According to the fire department, the area around the first-floor kitchen burned most intensely and is thought to be where the fire started. Police and firefighters are investigating whether a stove had been left on.

cards.defJa: 生産者や倉庫などから、商品を市場や店へ送り出すこと。

passage.ja: 高原の産地では、夏のレタスの出荷が最盛期を迎えている。農家は夜明け前から畑に出て、朝露に濡れたレタスを一つずつ手で収穫する。鮮度を保つため、箱詰めされたレタスはすぐに冷蔵トラックに積まれ、その日のうちに首都圏の市場へ運ばれる。今年は天候に恵まれ、出荷量は平年を上回る見込みだ。
passage.en: In the highland growing areas, summer lettuce shipments are at their peak. Farmers head out to the fields before dawn and harvest the dew-soaked lettuce by hand, one head at a time. To keep it fresh, the boxed lettuce is loaded straight onto refrigerated trucks and carried to markets in the Tokyo area the same day. Thanks to good weather this year, the volume shipped is expected to exceed the average.

cards.defJa: 事業などのために、お金を出すこと。

passage.ja: 電池の新技術を開発するベンチャー企業に、大手自動車メーカー三社が共同で出資することが決まった。出資額は合わせて百億円にのぼり、各社は株式の一部を保有する。メーカー側には、次世代の電気自動車に欠かせない技術をいち早く確保したいという狙いがある。一方、ベンチャー企業は得た資金で量産工場の建設を急ぐ考えだ。
passage.en: It has been decided that three major automakers will jointly invest in a venture company developing new battery technology. The investment totals 10 billion yen, and each company will hold part of the shares. The automakers aim to secure early on a technology that is essential to next-generation electric vehicles. The venture, for its part, plans to use the funds to hurry construction of a mass-production plant.

cards.meaning: running in a race; being entered as a starter
cards.defJa: 競馬や競走などのレースに出ること。

passage.ja: きょう午後に行われる競馬の大一番には、全国から選び抜かれた十八頭が出走する。中でも注目を集めているのは、三連勝中の若い馬だ。一方で、昨夜の雨で馬場が重いままなら、スタミナに定評のあるベテランの馬が有利になるとの見方もある。スタンドには朝早くから大勢のファンが詰めかけ、発走の時刻を待っている。
passage.en: Eighteen horses selected from around the country will run in this afternoon's big race. Drawing the most attention among them is a young horse on a three-race winning streak. Some, however, believe that if the track stays heavy from last night's rain, veteran horses known for their stamina will have the edge.
